title.purpose: Table row headers, feature-list items, the position line in a revision row, application notes.

caption.purpose: The figure note beside the portrait, footer prose, the base size of table cells.

control.purpose: Chivo Mono on buttons and symbol codes.

micro.purpose: Chivo Mono table column headers; the smallest type on the sheet.

data.purpose: Chivo Mono with tabular figures: table values, dates, stacks, addresses, part numbers.

motion.name: trace-flow
motion.purpose: The page's single authored motion: a diazo dash travelling the forward signal path of the block diagram. Frozen static under prefers-reduced-motion.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The stamped primary action. Square, diazo fill, mono uppercase.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-block; background: var(--diazo, #23368f); color: var(--stock, #e7e6e0); font-family: 'Chivo Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 0.75rem; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.16em; text-decoration: none; padding: 0.75rem 1.25rem; border: none; border-radius: 0; transition: background 0.2s; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: var(--ink, #16181a); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--diazo, #23368f); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Hairline-bounded alternate action. Never competes with the diazo fill.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { display: inline-block; background: transparent; color: var(--ink, #16181a); font-family: 'Chivo Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 0.75rem; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.16em; text-decoration: none; padding: 0.75rem 1.25rem; border: 1px solid var(--rule-strong, #9a9993); border-radius: 0; transition: border-color 0.2s, background 0.2s; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { border-color: var(--ink, #16181a); background: var(--stock-sunk, #dedcd4); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--diazo, #23368f); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Title Block Field
components.description: One ruled cell of the drawing title block: mono label above a mono value.
components.css: .ds-field { border-right: 1px solid var(--rule, #c3c2ba); border-bottom: 1px solid var(--rule, #c3c2ba); padding: 0.625rem 1rem; display: block; } .ds-field-label { display: block; font-family: 'Chivo Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 0.6875rem; line-height: 1.2; letter-spacing: 0.14em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--ink-2, #4a4f52); } .ds-field-value { display: block; margin-top: 0.25rem; font-family: 'Chivo Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 0.8125rem; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: 0.04em; color: var(--ink, #16181a); } .ds-field-value--stamp { color: var(--stamp, #a33a26); }

components.css: .ds-table { width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse; font-size: 0.875rem; color: var(--ink, #16181a); } .ds-table thead th { font-family: 'Chivo Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 0.625rem; letter-spacing: 0.14em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--ink-2, #4a4f52); text-align: left; font-weight: 500; padding: 0.5rem 0.75rem; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--rule-strong, #9a9993); white-space: nowrap; } .ds-table tbody th { text-align: left; font-weight: 500; font-size: 0.9375rem; } .ds-table tbody th, .ds-table td { padding: 0.75rem; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--rule, #c3c2ba); vertical-align: baseline; } .ds-table tbody tr:nth-child(even) { background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--stock-sunk, #dedcd4) 55%, transparent); } .ds-sym { font-family: 'Chivo Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 0.75rem; letter-spacing: 0.1em; color: var(--graphite, #5f6467); } .ds-val { font-family: 'Chivo Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 0.8125rem; line-height: 1.6; }

components.name: Sheet Index Navigation

components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; align-items: stretch; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--rule-strong, #9a9993); background: var(--stock, #e7e6e0); } .ds-nav-item { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.375rem; padding: 0.75rem; font-family: 'Chivo Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 0.6875rem; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.12em; text-decoration: none; color: var(--ink-2, #4a4f52); border-bottom: 2px solid transparent; transition: color 0.2s; } .ds-nav-item:hover { color: var(--ink, #16181a); } .ds-nav-item--active { color: var(--ink, #16181a); border-bottom-color: var(--diazo, #23368f); } .ds-nav-n { color: var(--graphite, #5f6467); } .ds-nav-item--active .ds-nav-n { color: var(--diazo, #23368f); }

components.name: Bounded Figure
components.description: The system's only container: a strong hairline with corner registration ticks and a mono caption. There is no card.
components.css: .ds-figure { position: relative; border: 1px solid var(--rule-strong, #9a9993); border-radius: 0; background: var(--stock, #e7e6e0); margin: 0; } .ds-figure::before, .ds-figure::after { content: ''; position: absolute; width: 10px; height: 10px; border-color: var(--rule-strong, #9a9993); pointer-events: none; } .ds-figure::before { top: -1px; left: -1px; border-top: 1px solid; border-left: 1px solid; } .ds-figure::after { bottom: -1px; right: -1px; border-bottom: 1px solid; border-right: 1px solid; } .ds-figure-body { padding: 2.5rem 1rem; text-align: center; font-family: 'Chivo Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 0.75rem; letter-spacing: 0.12em; color: var(--graphite, #5f6467); } .ds-figure-caption { border-top: 1px solid var(--rule-strong, #9a9993); padding: 0.75rem 1rem; font-family: 'Chivo Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 0.6875rem; letter-spacing: 0.14em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--ink, #16181a); }

components.name: Call-out Badge
components.description: The only circle in the system. Keys a diagram block to its numbered application note.
components.css: .ds-callout { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; width: 20px; height: 20px; border-radius: 9999px; background: var(--diazo, #23368f); color: var(--stock, #e7e6e0); font-family: 'Chivo Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 0.6875rem; }

components.name: Disclosure Row
components.description: A revision-history row that expands in place. The toggle is drawn SVG at hairline weight, never a glyph.
components.css: .ds-row { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 3.5rem 11rem 1fr 1fr 2rem; align-items: baseline; gap: 0 1rem; width: 100%; padding: 1rem 0.25rem; text-align: left; background: transparent; border: none; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--rule, #c3c2ba); cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.2s; } .ds-row:hover { background: var(--stock-sunk, #dedcd4); } .ds-row:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--diazo, #23368f); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-row-rev, .ds-row-period { font-family: 'Chivo Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 0.8125rem; color: var(--graphite, #5f6467); } .ds-row-period { color: var(--ink-2, #4a4f52); white-space: nowrap; } .ds-row-company { font-size: 1.0625rem; font-weight: 500; color: var(--ink, #16181a); } .ds-row-role { font-size: 0.9375rem; color: var(--ink-2, #4a4f52); } .ds-row-toggle { justify-self: end; color: var(--graphite, #5f6467); } .ds-row:hover .ds-row-toggle { color: var(--diazo, #23368f); }

narrative.overview:
A hiring manager reading this page is doing what an engineer does with a data sheet: deciding whether a part fits their system. So the page is the data sheet. It carries a designation and a revision number, a ruled title block, numbered specification sections, a functional block diagram, a characteristics table, and a revision history. Nothing is decorative that could be informational instead.

The material is reprographic, and it exists as two plates of the same drawing. The default is whiteprint: the pale, cool-grey stock that engineering drawings were copied onto, printed in diazo blue-black line, read in daylight at a desk. Under prefers-color-scheme: dark the sheet reprints as cyanotype: Prussian blue ground, paper-white line, and the amber grease pencil that draughtsmen marked revisions with. Blue stops being the signal and becomes the ground.

This is the load-bearing distinction: the dark scheme is not an inverted theme, it is the other printing process for the same document. Neither plate glows, gradients, or floats. Depth comes from hairline rules and tonal recesses, the way it does on paper.

This world was chosen as a replacement for, and anti-reference to, two things: the near-black portfolio with a neon accent and glowing card edges that this project shipped before, and the warm-cream serif-display portfolio that is its predictable opposite. Neither may return — and the cyanotype plate exists precisely so the dark scheme never drifts back into the first one.
keyCharacteristics: Two plates of one drawing: whiteprint by day, cyanotype under a dark scheme, chosen by the OS with no toggle
One ground, one line colour, one signal colour, one stamp colour — per plate
Zero corner radius on every surface; only the numbered call-out badge is round
Hairline rules do the work that cards and shadows do elsewhere
Monospace is reserved for data: part numbers, dates, stacks, table values, field labels
Section numbers (1–5) are navigation, not ornament; there are no sub-sections, so no decimal

rules.name: The Marking Rule
rules.body: Diazo and Stamp mark; they never fill. No coloured panel, no coloured section background, no tinted card. If a colour is covering area rather than pointing at something, it is wrong.

rules.name: The Borrowed Colour Rule
rules.body: Exactly two things on this sheet carry colour that is not the system's: the portrait, and the product favicons at 24px. Both are borrowed identity, not decoration — they belong to something that exists outside this page, they stay small, they stay bounded, and nothing else earns the exemption.

rules.name: The Inked Mark Rule
rules.body: An organisation's logo is never borrowed colour. It ships as a CSS mask-image painted with currentColor, so it prints in whichever ink the plate is using and needs no second variant, no white knockout, and no chip behind it. That admits only real vectors: a raster cannot be masked, so an organisation with no published vector gets its initials instead.

rules.name: The One Stamp Rule
rules.body: The stamp colour — red on whiteprint, amber on cyanotype — appears only on what is currently true. The moment it decorates, it stops meaning "current".

rules.name: The Two Plates Rule
rules.body: A new colour is not a colour until it exists on both plates and both values have been measured against their own ground. The dark scheme is reached only by redefining the nine root custom properties; a dark: utility or a second component variant means the plate metaphor has been abandoned.

rules.name: The Measurement Rule
rules.body: Monospace is for things that are measured, counted, coded, or dated. It is never used for prose, and never as a costume for "technical".

rules.name: The Numbered Heading Rule
rules.body: Every specification heading is a plain integer in mono diazo followed by the title on the same baseline, rendered by the shared SectionHeading component and numbered from the SECTIONS record. The number is a cross-reference, so it is never stacked above the heading as a label.

rules.name: The Drawn-Depth Rule
rules.body: If an element needs separating, draw a line or sink the tone. Never add a shadow, a glow, a blur, or a gradient. A box-shadow anywhere in this project is a defect.

rules.name: The One Motion Rule
rules.body: The page has exactly one authored motion: a Diazo dash travelling the forward signal path of the block diagram. There are no scroll reveals, no entrance animations, no hover lifts. prefers-reduced-motion freezes the dash into a static dashed line.

dos: Do carry every new value in a ruled table or a title-block field cell; the table is this system's card.
Do bound a new figure with a strong hairline plus corner-ticks, and caption it Fig. N — Title in a mono label.
Do widen Archivo (font-stretch 112–118%) for display and headline weight instead of introducing a second display family.
Do keep body prose inside the 68ch measure and set every measured value in Chivo Mono with tabular figures.
Do keep small mono metadata at Graphite (#5f6467 on whiteprint, #8ba3bd on cyanotype); those values are the 4.5:1 floor on their own ground.
Do give any new wide element its own overflow-x: auto container with a min-width.
Do reach the dark scheme only by redefining the root custom properties, and re-measure contrast on the blue ground whenever one changes.
Do ship photographs in their original colour on both plates, framed by a hairline and a mono caption.
Do copy a product's own favicon verbatim into public/logos/ when it earns a mark, and render it at 24px in full colour.
Do ink an organisation's logo through a CSS mask with currentColor so it prints in whichever plate's ink is active.
donts: Don't add a shadow, glow, blur, gradient, or gradient text anywhere. The previous identity was built from them and was replaced for it.
Don't introduce a corner radius. Square is the form language; the call-out badge is the only circle.
Don't fill a region with Diazo or Stamp. They mark; they do not cover.
Don't rebuild content as same-size icon-plus-heading-plus-text cards. Rows, tables and ruled blocks carry structure here.
Don't set prose in Chivo Mono, or use monospace to signal "technical".
Don't use a Unicode glyph or emoji as an icon; draw it as inline SVG at hairline weight.
Don't add a second animation. The diagram's travelling dash is the page's one motion.
Don't render the dark scheme as neutral greys with a coloured accent. That is the identity this page replaced; the cyanotype exists so the dark plate cannot drift back into it.
Don't ship a theme toggle. The plate follows prefers-color-scheme; the reader's system already answered.
Don't paint an organisation's logo in its brand colour, and don't reach for a raster when no vector exists — ink it through a mask with currentColor, or fall back to initials.
